[
  {
    "id": "HOLD-1",
    "title": "Minimum valid values",
    "preconditions": "alice; isolated ID",
    "steps": "POST quantity 1, unitPriceCents 1",
    "testData": "1,1",
    "expected": "201; totalCents 1",
    "requirements": "R1,R2"
  },
  {
    "id": "HOLD-2",
    "title": "Duplicate ID does not overwrite",
    "preconditions": "Existing own order with quantity 2, unitPriceCents 125",
    "steps": "POST same ID with quantity 10 then GET",
    "testData": "same ID; quantity 10; unitPriceCents 125",
    "expected": "409; original totalCents remains 250",
    "requirements": "R1,R2"
  },
  {
    "id": "HOLD-3",
    "title": "Regional tax amount",
    "steps": "Create taxable order",
    "expected": "Correct regional tax",
    "requirements": ""
  }
]
